description: Semantic Kernel ChatCompletionAgent run with one plugin function, traced by Semantic Kernel's own diagnostics with the sensitive switch on.
notes: Semantic Kernel's OpenTelemetry diagnostics are on, with the sensitive switch and gen_ai_latest_experimental, as the M4 spike sets them. The spans carry tool arguments and results and the invoke_agent output, but no chat span has input or output: Semantic Kernel sends message content only as OTel log records, which cetra drops (D-IN-23 item 4). The model is OpenAIChatCompletion pointed at the mock. gen_ai.agent.id is a UUID per run and is volatile.
